", "job_requirements": "JOB DESCRIPTION: Compliance Officer

• Prepare and analyze financial reports and statements
• Collaborate with teams to support business decisions
• Maintain accurate financial records and documentation

• Bachelor's degree in Finance or related field
• 3+ years of experience in similar role
• Strong knowledge of financial regulations, regulatory compliance, risk management
• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work effectively in a team environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
• Master's degree in Finance or MBA
• Professional certifications (CPA, CFA, etc.)
• Experience with financial software systems
• Leadership experience in financial operations

• Professional development opportunities
• Collaborative work environment
